data.long_meaning: Hasib is an Arabic name for boys that means 'calculator', 'one who calculates', 'one who reckons'. The name Hasib carries the meaning “Calculator, Reckoner” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hasib usually hope their child will grow to embody calculator, reckoner and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic context, Hasib is a Quranic name, derived from the word 'hasaba' (Arabic: حَسَبَ) which means 'to count', 'to calculate', 'to reckon'.
data.etymology: Hasib belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Calculator, Reckoner.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hasib total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: حاصِب
in_arabic.long_meaning: حاصِب: الاسم المشتق من الحسَب، وهو الإحسان والطاعة، ومعناه الطيب والخير، وعند بعض أهل اللغة، كان يُشير إلى الأَولاد، ويراد به الأَمر الطيب والمُفيد. ويُستخدم في الشعر والقصص الإسلامية لوصف الشخصية الطيبة والمُطيع.

in_urdu.name: حاصِب

in_urdu.long_meaning: حاصِب نام کا معنا پاکیزگی اور نعمتوں کی نشانی ہے۔ یہ نام اسلام کی ابتداء میں زیادہ استعمال ہوتا تھا۔ اس کا تعلق ہسَب سے ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے اچھائی اور مہربانی۔
